what: Several screen-height panels cross-fade with a Swiper fade every 8s over 1.4s. Inside the active panel a round window opens from 0 to 1 after a 1s delay while the photo inside settles from 2x to 1 (1s cubic-bezier(.49,.16,.15,1.04), a slight overshoot then settle). The big copy appears at 1.2s, and the title, text and button rows rise 10px over .8s starting at 1.8s with a .2s stagger. Panels that go out all return to their starting state at once after the fade ends, so they can open again next time — for big photo sequence panels like ‹Three reasons to choose us›

options.wait · open: Pause before the window opens (sec) · opening duration (sec), default 1 · 1
options.text · each: First delay of text lines (s) · gap between lines (s), default 1.8 · .2
options.[data-fx-part=track]: Swiper panel (.swiper > .swiper-wrapper > .swiper-slide) — omitted if the element itself is .swiper
options.[data-fx-part=window] · [data-fx-part=in: Round window and the picture inside (square)
options.[data-fx-part=copy] · [data-fx-part=line: (if present) large copy · lines that float up in turn (in order within the same parent)
